themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 8 THIS WEEK compared to a baseline average of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 6,300% increase—suggesting a coordinated campaign or sudden enforcement gap in CD 314.
evidence: 8 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 23.81)
6,300% spike in a single category suggests concentrated localized activity rather than seasonal trend
No Reddit or news coverage yet; raw 311 data is primary signal
reporting_angles: Canvas specific blocks in Midwood / Ocean Parkway to map the posting locations and identify whether a single actor or organized campaign is responsible
Interview Sanitation Department about whether staffing or enforcement changed this week that could explain the sudden spike

themes_detail.label: Construction & Plumbing Surge
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints jumped to 76 LAST WEEK, up 474% from the 8-week baseline average of 13.2 per week, indicating either a wave of unpermitted work or multiple major projects hitting problems simultaneously.
evidence: 76 construction/plumbing complaints last week vs. 13.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 15.14)
DOB records show 320 total alteration filings in the last 90 days; spike suggests concentrated activity window
5 encampment complaints last week (900% above baseline) and 13 obstruction complaints last week (215% above baseline) may be related side effects
reporting_angles: Cross-reference the 76 complaints against DOB permits filed in the same week to identify which specific projects are generating most complaints
Interview residents on blocks with highest complaint density to understand whether noise, safety hazards, or lack of notice is the primary grievance

themes_detail.label: Water System Failures
themes_detail.summary: Water system complaints surged to 60 TWO WEEKS AGO, up 256% from the 8-week baseline average of 16.9 per week, signaling a possible main break, service disruption, or quality issue affecting multiple blocks.
evidence: 60 water system complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 16.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.52)
Heat/hot water complaints remain highest category overall at 5,525 over 90 days; water system spike may explain some subset
General construction spike last week could indicate ongoing repairs from water event
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Environmental Protection to identify whether a water main break or service interruption occurred 2 weeks ago and which neighborhoods were affected
Cross-reference water system complaints with heat/hot water complaints to determine if they are linked or separate issues

themes_detail.label: Encampment Growth
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 5 LAST WEEK, up 900% from the 8-week baseline average of 0.5 per week, indicating either new outdoor sheltering activity or a reporting surge tied to enforcement.
evidence: 5 encampment complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.5)
Obstruction complaints also spiked last week (13 vs. 4.1 baseline), suggesting possible overlap in complaints
No Reddit or local news coverage yet; likely reflects on-the-ground reality that hasn't reached media attention
reporting_angles: Identify which specific locations generated the 5 encampment complaints and visit them to assess scope and conditions
Interview NYPD and parks enforcement to understand whether there was a policy change, sweep activity, or actual growth in unsheltered populations last week

themes_detail.label: Pigeon & Sanitation Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary pigeon condition complaints spiked to 4 THREE WEEKS AGO (700% above baseline of 0.5 per week) while sanitation worker complaints jumped to 5 LAST WEEK (300% above baseline of 1.2 per week), suggesting either pest management failures or service quality issues.
evidence: 4 pigeon complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.95)
5 sanitation worker/vehicle complaints last week vs. 1.2 weekly average (z-score: 4.52)
Overall unsanitary condition complaints remain high at 967 over 90 days, suggesting persistent baseline issue
reporting_angles: Map which parks or public spaces generated pigeon complaints to identify whether a specific location has a pest outbreak
Interview Sanitation Department about whether staffing changes or service cuts occurred that might explain worker complaint spike
